one_minute_value_explanation: AOF now stops Council execution before planning/build work proceeds when a required specialist role cannot be routed to a concrete actor.
thirty_second_version_delta: v10.7 checked that required capabilities were declared before build; v10.8 enforces that declared required roles are actually resolved into actor seats at Council execution time.
product_review_trigger: If an operator sees a registered specialist role missing from actual Council execution, reopen role routing as a product correctness issue, not a documentation issue.
not_proven: This delta proves structural runtime fail-closed routing only; it does not prove external project quality, game design correctness, or third-party adoption.
